items.title: VeriSign (VRSN) Will Launch The .Web Domain
items.summary: VeriSign (NasdaqGS: VRSN) plans to launch the .web top-level domain after securing ICANN approval following a prolonged dispute. The .web extension will be introduced through a phased rollout, expanding VeriSign's domain portfolio beyond its existing .com and .net offerings. Management describes .web as a major new addition to its registry portfolio that is expected to reshape the firm's product mix over time. items.summary: VeriSign has delivered a strong multi‑year run, and with the stock recently closing at US$313.02, the question is whether that price still lines up with the cash flows the business is expected to generate.
